dependence_robust_score_variance.fail_closed_condition: If V_HAC(S_adj) <= 0 or singular, report STATISTICAL_INFERENCE_NOT_READY and fail closed

null_baseline_model.null_hessian: H_0 = X_base' W X_base + Lambda_base, where W = diag(p_hat_i * (1 - p_hat_i))

scope_and_supersedence.defect_identified_in_clarification_002: Clarification 002 specified an LR bootstrap resampling raw x_micro in blocks while holding (X_base, y) fixed. The null hypothesis is H0: x_micro has no incremental predictive information for y conditional on X_base. H0 does NOT imply x_micro is independent of X_base. Resampling raw x_micro independently of X_base breaks contemporaneous dependence and distorts collinearity under the null.
scope_and_supersedence.preserved_unaffected: All other Clarification 002 provisions remain fully binding: primary Newey-West HAC covariance (lag 3), secondary Newey-West HAC covariance (lag 15), Holm-Bonferroni correction on HAC raw p-values, L2 logistic sandwich HAC covariance (lag 3) for the microstructure coefficient, and fail-closed forward health states.
scope_and_supersedence.scientific_integrity_attestation: Zero real fresh H39 validation outcomes were inspected prior to this clarification. This is an inferential validity correction committed before formal outcome unblinding, not result-driven retuning.
